To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the cyber incidents in Ukraine were mostly cyber operations, which do not fall under the definition of a cyber attack.

(1) the conflict in Ukraine has been a good example of how cyber operations can be used to harm an adversary; (2) the legal framework of international law has been used to justify the use of cyber operations; and (3) the legal framework is not sufficient to deal with the complexity of cyber operations.

the conflict in Ukraine has shown that the international legal framework in relation to cyberspace is insufficient, and the international society has to develop new rules to deal with cyber incidents in future conflicts.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following issues: 1) What are the main cyber incidents in the conflict in Ukraine?
the question of how the law can be applied to the cyber operations in the conflict in Ukraine and how the law could be applied to cyber incidents in general.
the question of how to define the status of the cyber incidents in the context of the conflict in Ukraine from the legal perspective.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the cyber operations during the conflict in the Ukraine are in compliance with international law.
cyber operations in the conflict in Ukraine are not in breach of international law.
the cyber incidents in Ukraine do not represent cyber attacks.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the cyber incidents realized in the conflict in Ukraine were not in the nature of cyber operations, but cyber operations.
the conflict in Ukraine is not only the first hybrid conflict but also the first cyber conflict.
cyber incidents are not considered as an act of war and are not regulated in a specific way by international law.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the legal framework for cyberspace is not yet sufficiently developed to provide a clear answer on the legality of cyber operations.
the legal approach to cyber operations during the conflict in the Ukraine is very complex and requires a more precise definition of the notion of cyber operation.
the conflict in Ukraine shows the need to further develop the legal framework of cyberspace.
